items.claim: Noah, his wife, his three sons Shem, Ham and Japheth, and their wives all enter the ark.
items.ruling: Not told here. The Qur’an has Nuh call to a son who stayed apart and was drowned (11:42-43), and gives the wife of Nuh as an example of those who disbelieved (66:10). The family taken aboard is “your family, except those about whom the word has preceded” (11:40).
items.basis: Qur’an 11:40-43; 66:10; the Bible text (Genesis 7:1-13, NRSVUE) read on BibleGateway

items.claim: Noah is six hundred years old when the flood comes.
items.ruling: The Qur’an says he remained among his people a thousand years minus fifty (29:14); it does not give his age at the flood. Ibn Kathir (abridged, on 11:40) says he called his people for 950 years. We neither believe nor disbelieve six hundred.
items.basis: Qur’an 29:14; Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com), on 11:40; the Bible text (Genesis 7:1-13, NRSVUE) read on BibleGateway
